csv_project_name: Design/Engineering for Stickney Point Road Park Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: Sarasota County Board of Commissioners may be seeking Design/Engineering service for Stickney Point Road Park Improvement. This approximately 2.04-acre Property is located at 1500 Stickney Point Road, Sarasota adjacent to the Stickney Point Drawbridge, also known as South Siesta Bridge, in unincorporated Sarasota County on the Intracoastal Waterway (ICW) in Little Sarasota Bay. The Property includes approximately 700 feet of bay frontage, 390 feet of canal/boat basin access, over 5,000 square feet of docks, boardwalks and deck, 72 dedicated parking spaces, and 21 individual parcels consisting of commercial condominiums. The buildings will be evaluated for operational functionality, however if they have no appropriate function and use, some or all may be demolished. Potential improvements may include water access such as a boat ramp and/or kayak launch, docks, fishing pier, two-pole picnic shelters, restroom, concessionaire, and parking.
